category_title: Emotionally disturbed primary student with trauma-related behavioral outbursts
scenario_title: Basic alphabet exercises in a large classroom
minimal_context: Jamal is sitting at his desk in a large classroom and is asked to write the basic alphabet on his paper.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jamal, it is time to practice our letters. Please take your pencil and write the basic alphabet on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pouts his lips) I can't see! My foot hurts...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You can see fine from your desk. Just start with the letter A.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have to go to the bathroom! My pencil broke!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish writing the alphabet first, then you can go.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts crying and kicks at his desk) I can't do it! (Tears his paper)
